name: circuitlens
description: CircuitLens - AI-assisted electronics troubleshooting web application

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run typecheck
